messages.subject: Choice of Likelihood
parts:
Dear all, 

I am very new to INLA, so my upfront apologies if this question sounds silly.

I am trying to implement INLA, but I would like to provide some evidence in my choice for the data likelihood, in here

Therefore, I would like to know if there's any statistic test that I could apply to test my data against the likelihood models in INLA.

I've been doing it with fitdist function from fitdistrplus package, but it doesnt have all the distributions that INLA has, that's why my question. 

Thanks in advance if anyone can give me a light on this one.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Choice of Likelihood
parts:
Hi,


we do not provide any test you can make for the likelihood. the model
is in most case so non-easy that this would not be possible. use common
sense and compare models...

H
